_comment: Proportional GUI texture remaps (ref-relative, any resolution). Each 'move' crops a region [x,y,w,h] (ref coords), clears the old spot to transparent, and pastes it at [dstX,dstY]. Used to realign GUI elements that Mojang repositioned. inventory: the 2x2 crafting grid + arrow + result moved (-10,+8) between 1.8.9 and modern (derived by matching vanilla old-vs-new); shift it to the modern position so it lines up with the functional slots. Clearing to transparent suits this pack's see-through inventory.
